scenes.title: Chosen as a Faithful Deacon
scenes.english_text: In the early church in Jerusalem, seven men full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom were chosen to help serve food to widows. Stephen was a man filled with faith and grace, and he served the community with joy while performing great wonders.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha kreda primetiva iha Jeruzalém, mane na'in-hitu ne'ebé nakonu ho Espíritu Santu no matenek hetan hili atu ajudador fahe ai-han ba feto-faluk sira. Estevão mak mane ida ne'ebé nakonu ho fiar no grasa, no nia servisu komunidade ho haksolok hodi halo milagre boot sira.
scenes.scene_summary: Stephen is chosen as one of seven deacons full of faith and the Holy Spirit to serve the early church.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a young Hebrew believer named Stephen with short dark hair, wearing a simple beige robe, smiling joyfully as he hands a basket of bread to an elderly woman in Jerusalem. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Speaking God's Truth Boldly
scenes.english_text: Stephen preached the good news of Jesus with great wisdom and power. When some religious leaders tried to argue with him, they could not withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke. Even when falsely accused, Stephen's face shone like the face of an angel.
scenes.tetum_translation: Estevão haklaken lia-foun di'ak Jesus nian ho matenek boot no kbiit. Bainhira lider relijiozu balu koko atu istória ho nia, sira la bele hasoru matenek no Espíritu ne'ebé nia ko'alia. Maski hetan duuk ho falsu, Estevão nia oin nabilan hanesan anju ida nia oin.
scenes.scene_summary: Stephen speaks God's truth with unshakeable wisdom and his face shines like an angel before the council.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a young man named Stephen standing courageously before a council of religious leaders, his face glowing softly with a gentle heavenly light. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Preaching the History of Faith
scenes.english_text: Before the council, Stephen gave a powerful speech reviewing the history of God's people from Abraham, Joseph, and Moses to Jesus. He explained that God does not live in buildings made by human hands and urged everyone to welcome God's Holy Spirit.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha konsellu nia oin, Estevão fó diskursu ho kbiit boot hodi hanoin fali istória Maromak nia povu nian husi Abraão, José, no Moisés to'o Jesus. Nia esplika katak Maromak la hela iha uma ne'ebé halo ho liman no husu ema hotu atu simu Maromak nia Espíritu Santu.
scenes.scene_summary: Stephen courageously preaches the history of God's salvation from Abraham to Jesus.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, Stephen standing tall with open arms, addressing a large group of attentive listeners in ancient Jerusalem. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: A Vision of Jesus in Heaven
scenes.english_text: While facing angry opposition, Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven. He saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God, and proclaimed, 'Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at God's right hand!'
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira hasoru ema sira-nia hirus, Estevão, nakonu ho Espíritu Santu, hateke metin ba lalehan. Nia haree Maromak nia glória no Jesus hamriik iha Maromak nia liman-kuana, no deklara, 'Haree! Ha'u haree lalehan nakloke no Oan-Mane hamriik iha Maromak nia liman-kuana!'
scenes.scene_summary: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Stephen gazes into heaven and sees Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, Stephen looking up to the glowing blue sky with joyful wonder, seeing golden heavenly light shining down on him. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Forgiving His Enemies with Grace
scenes.english_text: Even when faced with hostility outside the city, Stephen prayed peacefully, 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.' Then he fell on his knees and prayed with a loud voice, 'Lord, do not hold this sin against them!' After saying this, he passed peacefully into the arms of the Lord.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maski hasoru oin-aat iha sidade li'ur, Estevão harohan ho pás, 'Na'i Jesus, simu ha'u-nia espíritu.' Tuir mai nia monu ba ain-tubuk no harohan ho lia-boot, 'Na'i, keta tau sala ne'e ba sira!' Ko'alia tiha ne'e, nia toba ho pás iha Na'i nia liman laran.
scenes.scene_summary: Stephen prays for his spirit and asks God to forgive those who persecute him before passing peacefully into heaven.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, Stephen kneeling in prayer on a grassy field outside ancient city walls, looking up with peaceful light surrounding him in a calm afternoon glow. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Stephen teaches us to be filled with faith and grace, standing strong for Jesus and forgiving others even when they treat us unfairly.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Estevão hanorin ita atu nakonu ho fiar no grasa, hamriik metin ba Jesus no perdua ema seluk maski sira halo buat la loosa mai ita.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When someone is mean to you or disagrees with your faith, how can you show Jesus' love and forgiveness like Stephen did?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ema ruma aat ba ó ka la konkorda ho ó-nia fiar, oinsá ó bele hatudu Jesus nia domin no perdua hanesan Estevão halo?
